test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ______ today will be cloudy and humid.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noun "**weather**" refers to the atmospheric conditions at a particular time and place.
 
• The sentence is describing the atmospheric conditions for today, so the appropriate word to use is "**weather**".
 
• **Options 1, 3**, and 4 are incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The **weather**__ today will be cloudy and humid."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "waiter"** is incorrect because a waiter is a person who serves food and drinks in a restaurant.
 
• **Option 3: "wither"** is incorrect because wither means to become dry and shriveled.
 
• **Option 4: "whether"** is incorrect because whether is a conjunction used to express a doubt or choice between alternatives.
